description: This file defines a 'Filter' class used for parsing, matching, and handling filter expressions related to test case summaries, including tokenization, parsing, and query filtering functionalities.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A class for creating, parsing, and matching filters based on test case attributes such as project, status, text, labels, and annotations.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a filter expression string into a Filter object with tokens categorized by type.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Determines if a given test case summary matches the filter criteria.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the filter has no criteria set.
